diagnostic_threshold_scope: Reporting only, not reader qualification. Require matching finite boundaries, segment counts and no guarded-gap false length separately.
finite_structure_display_gate: Positive R/P >= 90%, exact declared segment count, boundary bijection <= 25 mm, zero guarded gap false length; same-segmentation diagnostic only.
development_replay: Previously scored 44 mixed, 36 section, 40 sampling and 32 support conditions form four separate development cohorts. All 152 are freshly inferred by local; the 304 supported results are exact same-input and same-policy frozen references, not new executions.
new_local_cohort: Eight independently authored families, two voxel scales and two physical sampling phases. Five positive families including full/half shells, a true gap, bare twin rods and noncoplanar rods with a short branch; unresolved rotating sparse arc and short-pitch helix; negative jittered sparse plane. Point-only representations are identical-input checks, not independent objects.
freeze_policy: Freeze all sources, unlabelled inputs, reference bindings and isolated truth before inference. Verify all 736 ordered normal/reference records, exact parent results, input hashes and policies before truth access. No post-score parameter changes or overwrites.
qualification: Five separate analytic/development cohorts, not independent real objects, foreground recognition, arbitrary topology or G1. Positive abstention is failure; retain ambiguous and erroneous nonempty outputs. No whole-scene promotion.
